title: An error in a French jazz-in-film book
summary: The caption wrongly places her in a film that doesn't exist; confusion with 'Swingin' the Dream'.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: We also found -- Do you remember that French book* about jazz in the movies that we found over there.
*Jean-Roland Hippenmeyer, Jazz Sur Films (Yverdon (Suisse): Editions de la Thiele, 1973).
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Which contains something that's categorically wrong, I think.
Yes. The caption is "Maxine Sullivan in Going Places." And there's no mention of --
Swinging The Dream. And, of course, it starts out with Bill Robinson and Shirley Temple, and a lot of other things that happened.
So, I think we came to the conclusion that the writer wrapping up the decade, and this was 1939, so he put everything in one... But there was no mention of anything from Swinging The Dream.
There is no movie by that name.
